Profile Ulinastatin is a glycoprotein proteolytic enzyme inhibitor isolat- ed from human urine. It has been given by slow intravenous injection or by intravenous infusion in acute pancreatitis (p.2361) and in acute circulatory insufficiency. ◊ References. 1. Ohwada M, et al.
